name: ICW World Championship
epitaph: The federation's top title, first contested on its debut Adrenaline broadcast of 21 November 2002, where the Canadian Crippler pinned Jared Hart to become its first champion. One reign is recorded.

name: ICW Women's Championship
epitaph: Awarded without a match on the debut Adrenaline broadcast of 21 November 2002 to Jade Evans, the one woman to answer the call for a women's battle royal. One reign is recorded.
